build_ConvTBC_module: build a ConvTBC module with specified in_channels, out_channels, and kernel_size for 1D convolution
create_ConvTBC_with_padding: create a ConvTBC convolutional layer with custom padding for time-batch-channel input tensors
run_ConvTBC_forward: run the forward pass of a ConvTBC module on a time-batch-channel shaped input tensor
test_ConvTBC_conv_tbc: test the conv_tbc method of ConvTBC to verify 1D convolution over TBC-shaped tensors
review_ConvTBC_init: review the ConvTBC __init__ to understand weight and bias parameter initialization for gemm-based convolution
